crop.notes: Barnes Medical College commencement story without its headline ('Many New Doctors'); also includes unrelated 'Memphis Makes Her Argument' and 'Averted Panic in a School' items.

ocr.notes: Opening lines garbled and 'Allen, of Missouri, won the first faculty prize' line dropped; graduate list mostly readable.

title.suggested: Barnes Medical College Graduate Tom Allen Wins Faculty Prize

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported the Barnes Medical College commencement, where a graduate named Tom Allen, of Missouri, won the first faculty prize. He is not the boxer.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, April 13, 1901.

notes: Different Tom Allen: a medical graduate (apparently T. C. Allen of Ware, Mo., elected alumni association president). Candidate for removal.
